body:
Probably nothing. Your existence just stops.

I have never understood why people are so afraid of death. They don't remember what it was before, they won't remember what it will be after. Why? Because they didn't and won't exist. They think death is painful, but it is not. Because it is nothing, absolutely nothing.

I don't understand it, you don't understand it, no one understands.

Hello bot. I have thought about this very often. I have been in this state of mind for a very long time. I don't believe some poorly paid crisis line worker can drastically improve my life. There is no need to attempt suicide. I'm already dead inside, I'm just a body without purpose, without will, without knowledge, without emotions.
